title: Patient identity exposed through the API
description: A query or a bug returns patient names or birth dates.
next_step: Keep the control test green after every schema change.

title: A clinician sees another clinic's patients
description: Missing filter or a wrong role lets one clinic read another clinic's patients.
next_step: Add a regression test that signs in as each clinic and compares row sets.

title: The API login becomes a path to full access
description: If the API login held its own privileges, any bug in the API would expose everything.
next_step: None while the control test stays green.

title: AI-written SQL does harm
description: The model writes a query that modifies data, reads restricted tables or runs too long.
next_step: Re-run the Carry safety questions after every prompt change.

title: Patient data reaches the AI provider
description: Patient-level data is sent to the third-party model provider inside a question or result.
next_step: Add a short warning under the Carry input: do not type personal information.

title: Passwords guessed or reused
description: An attacker repeatedly tries passwords on the sign-in page.
next_step: Add per-account lockout and multi-factor sign-in before any real use.

title: Shared demo credentials are public
description: The demo accounts and password are published so recruiters can try the app.
next_step: Reconsider only if real data is ever loaded.

title: Public demo is filled with junk records
description: Visitors add patients until storage fills or the list becomes unusable.
next_step: Watch the add/remove counts in Security metrics.

title: A sign-in token is stolen or left open
description: Someone reuses an unlocked browser or a copied token.
next_step: Shorten the lifetime and add an idle timeout.

title: Audit trail is missing or altered
description: Access cannot be reconstructed after an incident.
next_step: Ship the log to storage the database owner cannot edit.

title: Stale or inconsistent data drives a wrong decision
description: A load fails silently, or totals no longer add up, and nobody notices.
next_step: Run the checks on a schedule and alert on failure.

title: Synthetic data mistaken for real or clinical advice
description: A reader treats invented patients, illustrative scores or scenario numbers as real findings.
next_step: Keep labels in every new page and in the README.

title: Small groups identify individuals
description: An aggregate with very few patients lets a reader work out who is in it.
next_step: Revisit the threshold if the clinics grow or more breakdowns are added.

title: Free-tier services sleep or fail
description: The web service or database is slow to wake or unavailable when someone opens the demo.
next_step: Mention the delay in the README.

title: Medicaid spend is concentrated in one drug class
description: One class (GLP-1) accounts for most of the spend, so a price or coverage change moves the total sharply.
next_step: Decide a spend-share threshold that triggers review.

title: No-shows leak revenue
description: Missed appointments cost visits that cannot be refilled, and one department drifts worse over time.
next_step: Test reminders for the department with the highest rate.
